description: Convert a value between units of length, area, volume (US customary and metric, cooking measures), mass, speed, pressure, energy, power, data size (SI and binary), time and temperature. Factors are exact to the definitions in NIST SP 811 (international inch and pound, US gallon, calorie IT, Btu IT, mechanical horsepower). An unknown unit is a 400 that lists every supported unit. Pure code, no outside source. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

from.description: Unit to convert from, e.g. mi, kg, F, GiB, kWh, gal_us

to.description: Unit to convert to, of the same kind, e.g. km, lb, C, MB

value.description: The number to convert, up to 1e15 in size
